name: Chart/Donut-Chart
description:
Donut chart: shares of one total as 5+ slices in palette order (Chart/Sector/Primary, Secondary, Support Cyan, Violet, Yellow Solid) with 4px gaps, the ring 22% of the diameter, a Surface/Default % pill (Label/Small/Medium, Corner-Radius/Rounded) on every slice of 6% or more, the total in the centre (Heading/4 + Caption/Regular) and a legend below or at the start. Size (code: DonutChart size): Small 120 (the centre figure alone, Body/Base/Bold), Medium 168 (default), Large 240, XLarge 320 (Heading/3 figure). Pick Small for a tile or a row of several charts, Large or XLarge for a wide or tall card. Content only, no surface of its own: place it in a Chart-Card's (or a Card's) Content slot, and the card gives the theme. Code: DonutChart + ChartCard (src/components/Chart)

Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (the first two slices swap), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary".
